name: vibe-wise
description: You build. AI writes. Learn how to build software while Codex writes the code.

interface.shortDescription: Learn to build software while Codex writes the code
interface.longDescription: VibeWise puts learning first. Codex asks for your approach, helps you examine tradeoffs, and explains unfamiliar concepts. You own the design and decide when it's ready; Codex writes the agreed code and explains what it changed.
